description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InspectorateReport" name="Work accident report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Work accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Accident report by self-employed person to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport" name="Educational institution accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport" name="Accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Employer_Inspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident if emergency services have not reported it" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_InspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Employer_Insurance" name="Report qualifying work accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployed_Insurance" name="Report accidents involving the self-employed person or employed people in good time" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Student_Directorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_DirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_School_Insurance" name="Report every qualifying work accident in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Private_Insurance" name="Report accident in writing immediately" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurance" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Private_Fatality" name="Report fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employee notification and employer reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Employer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_EmployeeIncident</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyEmployer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employer" name="Employer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessReportingDuties</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportInspectorate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportEmployerInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_EmployerReporting</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Employee has a work accident, near accident, discovers a serious and immediate safety or health risk, or finds a protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessReportingDuties" name="Gather accident information and assess reporting duties">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, a work accident may include an accident at a location, time and with a cause correlating to the insured employment; while working from home; on the direct route from the permanent residence to work, to lunch or home, including carpools; during professional training or on the way to or from the training centre; on a direct route from home, the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back when this interrupts the direct route to work or home, provided the doctor's visit was notified to the employer in advance; on the way to or from work or training to take a child to or collect a child from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; or while making use of advocacy groups or professional associations.
For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include an accident at a location, time and with a cause correlating to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; during a school or school-related event; on the direct route from the child's residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or school and home; while performing a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; or in certain professional training orientations.
In an agricultural or forestry establishment, covered tasks may include work in the owner's or employee's household when it serves the establishment to a considerable extent; work connected with providing accommodation for guests; secondary occupations selling agricultural products from the farm; work erecting, converting or repairing buildings that serve the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment.
Accidents outside professional activity may also be considered work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labour Market Promotion Act (for example, on the way to an arranged job interview); assisting with an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of the Volunteer Fire Brigade, Volunteer Water Rescue Service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingSplit" name="Which independent employer reporting duties apply?" default="Flow_NoEmployerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Immediately report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate if emergency services have not reported it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingJoin" name="Continue after applicable reports"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerReporting" name="Employer reporting duties completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeIncident_Notify" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Assess" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Task_AssessReportingDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Split" sourceRef="Task_AssessReportingDuties" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_Required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The work accident caused a fatality or serious injury and has not been reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A person with accident insurance was killed or injured so that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoEmployerReport" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingSplit" targetRef="End_EmployerReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportingJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingJoin" targetRef="End_EmployerReporting"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="An accident involving the self-employed person or an employed person occurs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReporting" name="Accident report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReporting"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student and schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="An accident involving a student or schoolchild occurs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReporting" name="Accident reported to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_StudentReporting"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="Educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SchoolAccident" name="A work accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report every qualifying work accident to accident insurance provider in triplicate within a maximum of five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReporting" name="Accident insurance report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="End_SchoolReporting"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsurance" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="A privately insured accident occurs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurance" name="Report accident in writing to private insurer immediately, in accordance with policy conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality report sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateNoFatality" name="Immediate accident report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A fatality occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateNoFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No fatality occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateFatality"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
